title: VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token
title_zh: VideoMaMa++：通过保留与精修令牌实现时序一致的视频抠像

paragraphs.en: VideoMaMa++提出保留与精修令牌机制，实现长视频抠像的时序一致性并提升细节精度。 Diffusion-based video matting has recently emerged as a leading approach, leveraging video diffusion priors from internet-scale pretraining to achieve strong zero-shot generalization from limited synthetic data. However, the heavy compute of these diffusion backbones limits inference to a short chunk of just 6 to 24 frames, so even ordinary videos span multiple chunks. Because each chunk is matted independently from coarse mask guidance, existing methods fail to maintain consistency across chunk boundaries, producing flickering edges and discontinuous transparency. We address this with a mask-guided diffusion-matting framework built on two ideas. The RGB and mask conditioning are represented as separate token streams that interact through full spatio-temporal self-attention, letting the model adaptively combine fine RGB texture with coarse mask layout rather than committing to a fixed channel-wise fusion. On top of this, we propose a novel pair of learnable embeddings, the preserve token and the refine token, that act as a per-frame conditioning interface and enable a sliding-window inference scheme in which already-generated mattes are propagated across chunk boundaries for local temporal consistency, complemented by a globally shared reference anchor at every chunk to prevent error accumulation in long sequences without any additional training. Across standard video matting benchmarks and in-the-wild long footage, our framework outperforms prior diffusion-based methods in both fine-detail accuracy and temporal consistency, and uniquely maintains consistency across chunk boundaries on long videos.
paragraphs.zh: VideoMaMa++提出保留与精修令牌机制，实现长视频抠像的时序一致性并提升细节精度。基于扩散的视频抠像近来已成为一种领先方法，它利用互联网规模预训练获得的视频扩散先验，在有限的合成数据下实现强大的零样本泛化能力。 然而，这些扩散主干高昂的计算开销使推理只能处理6到24帧的短片段，因此即使是普通视频也会跨越多个片段。 由于每个片段都在粗略掩码引导下独立抠像，现有方法无法在片段边界处保持一致性，产生边缘闪烁和透明度不连续的问题。 我们基于两个理念构建了一个掩码引导的扩散抠像框架来解决这一问题。 RGB与掩码条件被表示为独立的令牌流，并通过完整的时空自注意力进行交互，使模型能够自适应地结合精细的RGB纹理与粗略的掩码布局，而不是固守固定的逐通道融合方式。 在此基础上，我们提出一对新颖的可学习嵌入——保留令牌与精修令牌，它们充当逐帧条件接口，并支持一种滑动窗口推理方案：已生成的抠像结果跨越片段边界传播以实现局部时序一致性，同时在每个片段辅以全局共享的参考锚点，无需任何额外训练即可防止长序列中的误差累积。 在标准视频抠像基准和真实场景长视频上，我们的框架在细节精度与时序一致性两方面均优于先前基于扩散的方法，并且在长视频上独有地保持跨片段边界的一致性。
